description: SaaS subscription with auto-renewal, cancellation fees, and price escalation clause

expected_findings.evidence_quote: This Agreement shall automatically renew for additional 12-month periods unless cancelled in writing 60 days before the end of the current term
Company reserves the right to increase fees by up to 15% annually upon 30 days notice
Early Termination Fee: $500.00 or 50% of remaining contract value, whichever is greater
